title: What a record gives you
statement: Which statements about record Point(int x, int y) {} are true in Java 21? Pick every one that applies.
choices: x and y become private final fields, read through the accessors x() and y().
It can extend another class, as in record Point(int x, int y) extends Shape {}.
It can declare an extra instance field in its body, such as private int cache;.
equals(), hashCode() and toString() are generated from its components.
